mintAuthority.summary: At Celo block 78972424, AUDm issuance uses the V2 Broker and legacy BiPoolManager. The two-day Mento Timelock owns the token and Broker and can raise trading limits. The BiPoolManager pricing/configuration owner is a separate 4-of-6 migration Safe. Validators is token-authorized, but its current mint function targets registry USDm and only registry EpochManager can invoke it. Celo Governance owns both the Validators proxy and Registry: upgrades or registry reassignment can enable a latent AUDm mint path. No Mento Timelock protection is attributed to Celo Governance.

controls.label: Mento Broker — authorized minter for AUDm
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, token broker() is the V2 Broker and token/Broker owner and proxy admin are Mento Timelock; getMinDelay() is 172800 seconds. Verified Broker configureTradingLimit is onlyOwner: this resolves cap configuration to the Timelock, not the public swap path.

controls.label: Mento Timelock — AUDm token owner and proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, token broker() is the V2 Broker and token/Broker owner and proxy admin are Mento Timelock; getMinDelay() is 172800 seconds. Verified Broker configureTradingLimit is onlyOwner: this resolves cap configuration to the Timelock, not the public swap path.

controls.label: Celo ValidatorsProxy - authorized AUDm minter slot
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, AUDm validators() points here; current implementation is 0x13b0b89f3242f815c1fc6c9cf56e1ab5aea4dc58. Its sole mint call is onlyRegisteredContract(EpochManager) and targets Registry StableToken, currently USDm 0x765de816845861e75a25fca122bb6898b8b1282a. There is no AUDm-targeting or generic call in the current implementation; mutable Registry and proxy controls are recorded separately.

controls.label: Celo GovernanceProxy - Validators and Registry authority
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, ValidatorsProxy _getOwner(), Registry owner(), and Registry proxy _getOwner() resolve to Celo Governance. Validators currently mints only Registry USDm to registered EpochManager. Registry setAddressFor is onlyOwner and can replace StableToken and EpochManager; the Validators implementation is separately replaceable by this owner. These mutable target/caller and upgrade paths can authorize AUDm issuance without attributing the Mento Timelock delay to Celo Governance.

controls.label: Mento migration Safe - legacy FX pool configuration
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78972424, BiPoolManager owner() is this 4-of-6 Safe; getModulesPaginated returns no enabled modules and the guard slot is zero. Verified BiPoolManager source permits owner-only pricing-module, oracle, spread and exchange configuration that determines Broker issuance quotes. It cannot call Broker configureTradingLimit, which is restricted to the separate Broker owner. BiPoolManager proxy administration remains the Mento Timelock.
